dogecoin.text: IMHO #TSLA sky high valuation is about to be tested severely in the next few weeks. Rising input costs, #DogeCoin buyers, producer price inflation in #China , increasing success at #SpaceX will all distract and challenge musk. #deflation in growth stocks is also inevitable.

A man who can propound A.I. Suddenly became aware of the energy use of #btc via a Cambridge chart is laughable. I think @elonmusk realised that the ESG credentials of #tsla were undermined by accepting a dark unfathomable digital worm, and that backfired. So #dogecoin it is.

Musk appears to be encountering strategic dissonance. @Tesla valuation cannot hold these levels given rising commodity prices, increasing competition at the high end and @elonmusk making rudimentary mistakes about #BTC and #dogecoin.

Musk is destroying #TSLA by going on #snl talking up #dogecoin and making incoherent arguments about FSD  and strategy . #technoking needs a new gig and he should walk into the sunset. A job well done so far  should be handed over to someone else.
